scope: synthetic Korean consumer-finance retrieval for Metadata Filter and claim-level first-stage candidate generation; not factual financial advice, product quality evidence, or legal interpretation
split_policy: scenario-family-disjoint from v1, v2, v3, v4 and within v5; author-visible, provider-unmeasured gate set; not independently blind
filter_policy: Metadata Filter keeps a document when the query's target institution matches, the query's target product matches when set, and as_of_date falls in [effective_from, effective_to]. Every claim constrains institution and date only; product is never used because AI-006 treats product identification as something to verify rather than assume and product filtering would collapse the candidate space to one family.
query_policy: One query is one claim: a single fact the user asserts or reports being told. truth is TRUE, FALSE or PARTIAL. A FALSE claim's relevant unit is the document that refutes it. A case is five claims from the same input; the case pool is the union of the five claim pools. Decided 2026-09-05 after v3/v4 paragraph-level measurements missed 1.00; pass line, pool size and filter contract are unchanged.
